{{Top|leg}}
A '''coagulant''' was a standard treatment to treat wounds, causing [[Blood/Legends|blood]] to clot<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref> and to stop the bleeding.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> It was standard equipment for [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]].<ref name="RPG" />
